newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S RESERVE BANK BUYS DOLLARS AT 35.725 RUPEES.
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S RESERVE BANK BUYS DOLLARS AT 35.725 RUPEES.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought dollars at the 35.725 level in early afternoon Friday trade, dealers at two leading foreign banks said.
The rupee was at the 35.7150 level in the morning and dealers said the central bank intervened as the rupee was gaining in the absence of corporate demand, dealers said.
The rupee opened nearly steady at 35.710/715 a dollar.
The spot rupee was at 35.720/730 in latest deals.
